title: Small-time approximate controllability of bilinear Schrödinger equations on compact normal homogeneous spaces
summary: We prove small-time global approximate controllability in $L^2$ for bilinear Schrödinger equations on compact connected normal homogeneous spaces. The controls act through finitely many smooth real-valued potentials. We first construct finite saturating families on compact connected Lie groups endowed with bi-invariant metrics, using Peter-Weyl theory and the Casimir operator. Their phase saturation contains the representative algebra and is therefore dense in $L^2$.
